---
title: "Topic: collaboration and knowledge transfer"
---

**Collaboration incidence**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm cooperates with other firms or organisations on innovation or business activities
- **Metric:** Binary indicator (yes/no); number of active partnerships
- **Data source:** Primary survey

---

**Partner diversity**

- **Definition:** The range of partner types the firm collaborates with (suppliers, universities, competitors, etc.)
- **Metric:** Number of distinct partner types; diversity index
- **Data source:** Primary survey

---

**University-industry linkages**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm has formal collaboration with universities or public research institutes
- **Metric:** Binary indicator; number of joint projects; value of contracted research (€)
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (research funding records)

---

**Researcher-industry linkages**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm has formal collaboration with researchers
- **Metric:** Binary indicator; number of joint projects; value of contracted research (€)
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (research funding records)

---

**Cluster or network participation**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm participates in an innovation cluster, industry network, or competitiveness pole
- **Metric:** Binary indicator (yes/no); number of networks participated in
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (cluster membership records)
